json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter & Validator
json-formatter.description: Format, validate, and beautify your JSON data directly in the browser. Detect syntax errors, copy results, and download formatted output.

faq.q: Is my JSON data sent to a server?
faq.a: No. All formatting and validation happens entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
Standard JSON (RFC 8259). Objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null are all supported.

faq.q: Can I download the formatted result?
faq.a: Yes. Use the Download button to save the formatted JSON as a .json file.

code-formatter.name: Code Formatter
code-formatter.short: Format and prettify code in multiple languages
code-formatter.description: Format and beautify source code across multiple programming languages with clean, syntax-aware output.

faq.a: JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, CSS, HTML, and more are supported through dedicated formatters.

html-formatter.name: HTML Formatter
html-formatter.description: Format, prettify, and indent HTML markup with customizable indentation for cleaner, more readable code.

faq.q: Does this support inline CSS and JS?
faq.a: Yes. The formatter handles inline styles and scripts while preserving your HTML structure.

css-formatter.name: CSS Formatter
css-formatter.description: Format and prettify CSS stylesheets, or minify them for production use with one click.

faq.a: No. Minification only removes whitespace and comments, preserving all functional rules.

javascript-formatter.name: JavaScript Formatter
javascript-formatter.description: Format, prettify, and beautify JavaScript code with syntax-aware indentation and consistent styling.

faq.q: Does this support modern ES6+ syntax?
faq.a: Yes. Arrow functions, destructuring, async/await, and other modern syntax are fully supported.

base64.name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
base64.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, with full Unicode support and file handling.
base64.inputPlaceholder: Enter text to encode or Base64 to decode...

faq.a: Yes. The tool handles UTF-8 encoding properly, including emoji and non-Latin scripts.

url-encoder.name: URL Encoder / Decoder
url-encoder.description: Encode URLs or URI components to safely transmit special characters, and decode them back when needed.

faq.q: What's the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
faq.a: encodeURI preserves reserved URL characters like :/?#&=, while encodeURIComponent encodes everything except A-Z, a-z, 0-9, and a few symbols.

uuid-generator.name: UUID Generator
uuid-generator.description: Generate one or multiple UUIDs (v4) instantly, with copy and download options for bulk generation.

faq.a: Yes. UUID v4 uses random values, making collisions astronomically unlikely.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate strong, random passwords with customizable length and character sets. Includes a strength indicator.

faq.q: Are these passwords safe to use?
faq.a: Yes. Passwords are generated using the browser's cryptographically secure random generator.

qr-code.name: QR Code Generator
qr-code.short: Create QR codes from text or URLs
qr-code.description: Generate QR codes from any text, URL, or contact info. Download as PNG or SVG with customizable size and colors.
qr-code.inputPlaceholder: Enter text or URL to encode...

faq.a: Up to ~2,953 alphanumeric characters, depending on the error correction level.

markdown-previewer.name: Markdown Previewer
markdown-previewer.description: Write Markdown and see a live, formatted preview side by side. Safe HTML rendering with copy and download options.

faq.a: Yes. HTML is sanitized to prevent XSS attacks while still rendering standard Markdown.

regex-tester.name: Regex Tester
regex-tester.short: Test regular expressions with live highlighting
regex-tester.description: Test regular expressions with live match highlighting, group capture display, and clear error messages.

faq.a: Standard JavaScript regular expressions (similar to PCRE with some limitations).

text-diff.name: Text Diff Checker
text-diff.short: Compare two texts and highlight differences
text-diff.description: Compare two blocks of text and clearly see additions, removals, and changes with inline highlighting.

faq.a: A line-based diff algorithm that produces clear, readable results for most use cases.

word-counter.name: Word & Character Counter
word-counter.short: Count words, characters, lines, and more
word-counter.description: Instantly count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time for any text.

faq.a: Based on an average reading speed of 200 words per minute.

case-converter.name: Case Converter
case-converter.short: Convert text to any case format
case-converter.description: Convert text between lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and kebab-case.

faq.a: Yes. All case conversions preserve Unicode characters including accented letters.

image-compressor.name: Image Compressor
image-compressor.description: Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images with adjustable quality. Drag-and-drop, before/after comparison, all client-side.

faq.a: No. All compression happens locally using the HTML Canvas API.

image-resizer.name: Image Resizer
image-resizer.description: Resize images by width or height with optional aspect ratio lock. Drag-and-drop upload and instant download.

faq.a: Up to your browser's canvas limit (typically 16,384 x 16,384 pixels).

image-cropper.name: Image Cropper
image-cropper.description: Crop images interactively with aspect-ratio presets and rotation. Download the cropped result instantly.

faq.q: Can I crop to a custom aspect ratio?
faq.a: Yes. Use the Free aspect ratio option to crop to any dimensions.

image-converter.name: Image Format Converter
image-converter.short: Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP
image-converter.description: Convert images between PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP formats with preview and quality controls.

faq.a: PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP — covering all modern browser and web use cases.

svg-optimizer.name: SVG Optimizer
svg-optimizer.description: Optimize SVG markup by removing metadata, comments, and unnecessary attributes. See before/after file sizes.

faq.a: No. Only redundant data is removed — the visible result remains identical.

color-converter.name: Color Converter & Picker
color-converter.description: Pick colors and convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL formats with live preview and one-click copy.

faq.a: Yes. All conversions use the standard sRGB color space.

timestamp-converter.name: Timestamp Converter
timestamp-converter.description: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa, with seconds/milliseconds and timezone support.

faq.a: Seconds or milliseconds since January 1, 1970 UTC (the Unix epoch).

video-converter.name: Video Format Converter
video-converter.short: Convert video formats in the browser
video-converter.description: Convert video files between common formats using FFmpeg WASM. Fully client-side processing with progress feedback.

faq.a: Conversion uses FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly, which runs entirely in your browser. Speed depends on your device.

video-compressor.name: Video Compressor
video-compressor.description: Compress video files with quality/size controls using FFmpeg WASM. All processing happens in your browser.

faq.a: Constant Rate Factor — lower values produce higher quality but larger files. 18-28 is typical for web video.

audio-converter.name: Audio Converter
audio-converter.short: Convert audio formats in the browser
audio-converter.description: Convert audio files between common formats (MP3, WAV, OGG) using FFmpeg WASM. Drag-and-drop with progress feedback.

faq.a: Common formats including MP3, WAV, OGG, and AAC, depending on browser codec support.

tiktok-date-extractor.name: TikTok Date Extractor
tiktok-date-extractor.short: Estimated publish date from a TikTok link
tiktok-date-extractor.description: Paste a TikTok video URL to reveal its estimated creation date. The date is derived from the video ID and shown in UTC.
tiktok-date-extractor.note: The displayed date is estimated from the video ID. It is not verified with TikTok. The result is shown in UTC.

empty.title: Paste a TikTok video link to start

errors.emptyUrl: Please paste a TikTok link first
errors.invalidUrl: The entered URL is not valid.
errors.notTikTok: This URL does not come from TikTok.
errors.noVideoId: Could not find a Video ID in this URL.
errors.invalidId: The TikTok link contains an invalid identifier.
errors.noTimestamp: Impossible to extract a date from this video.
errors.invalidDate: Could not convert the timestamp into a date.

faq.a: TikTok video IDs encode a creation timestamp. The first 31 bits of the ID are read as a Unix timestamp, then displayed in UTC.
It is an estimate derived from the ID structure, not a value fetched from TikTok. It is usually very close to the real publish time.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: DigiTools is built privacy-first. This policy explains what happens (and what does not happen) when you use our tools.

sections.heading: No account, no tracking
sections.body: DigiTools does not require an account. We do not use analytics, advertising trackers, or third-party pixels. We do not sell or share personal data, because we do not collect it.

sections.heading: Processing stays in your browser
sections.body: All tools run entirely in your browser. Your files, text, and results are never uploaded to a server. Conversion, compression, and formatting happen locally on your device.

sections.heading: Local storage only
sections.body: We store a few preferences in your browser (theme, language) using localStorage and a cookie. These never leave your device and are not linked to an identity.

sections.heading: No user content retention
sections.body: Because processing is local, we have no copy of the data you enter or the files you open. Closing the tab removes it from the page; clear your browser storage if you want to remove preferences.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes materially, we will update this page. Continued use of DigiTools after changes means you accept the updated policy.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about privacy? Contact Digit'Tech Group, the operator of DigiTools.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using DigiTools you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Use of the service
sections.body: DigiTools provides free browser-based utility tools for developers, writers, and creators. You may use them for personal and commercial purposes within the limits of applicable law.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: The tools are provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, accuracy of results, or fitness for a particular purpose. Always verify critical outputs.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
sections.body: You are responsible for the data and files you process. Do not use DigiTools for unlawful purposes. Because processing is local, you alone control and retain your content.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The DigiTools name, logo, interface, and code are owned by Digit'Tech Group or its licensors. You may not copy or redistribute the site wholesale without permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Digit'Tech Group shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of DigiTools.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. The "last updated" date on this page reflects the latest version. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the changes.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: DigiTools uses a minimal set of cookies and local storage entries. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are used.

sections.heading: Essential preferences
sections.body: We store your language choice (toolforge-locale) and theme preference so the site remembers them between visits. These are functional, not tracking, cookies.

sections.heading: Service worker
sections.body: A service worker may cache assets for offline use. It does not profile you or send data to third parties.

sections.heading: No ad cookies
sections.body: We do not use Google Analytics, advertising networks, or social media pixels. There are no third-party tracking cookies on DigiTools.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can clear cookies and site data at any time in your browser settings. The site will work; you may need to re-select your language or theme.
